components.quote: The vaccine contains 6 mg of sorbitol per dose.

components.label: Excipients with known effect
components.quote: The vaccine contains 331 micrograms of phenylalanine per dose (see section 4.4).

related.note: 瓶塞／針筒活塞材質為 bromobutyl rubber（合成橡膠），非天然乳膠(latex)；仿單未就 latex 過敏另作聲明

dismissed.egg: 全文掃描6個「chick」命中皆為 chickenpox（水痘疾病名）字串誤命中，與蛋／卵白蛋白無關
dismissed.latex: 全文掃描3個「rubber」命中皆為 p.13 瓶塞/活塞材質 bromobutyl rubber（合成丁基橡膠）之重複擷取，非天然乳膠(latex)，已列為 related

warnings.label: 過敏禁忌
warnings.quote:
Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients listed in section 6.1
or to neomycin. However, a history of contact dermatitis to neomycin is not a
contraindication.
